name: Heartopia
label: Cozy life
blurb: A slow-living game about decorating, gardening, and strolling around a small town.
seoDescription: Heartopia Shorts from Haejoy: cozy decorating, gardening and slow evening walks in a small-town life sim, cut into calm clips for a tea break.
description: Heartopia is a cozy life sim built around small, gentle routines: tending a garden, decorating a home room by room, and wandering a little town where nothing is in a hurry.

It is the kind of game that fits the channel perfectly. A Heartopia Short is usually one quiet moment, like a new furniture layout, an evening walk, or a garden finally coming together, cut down to something you can watch with a cup of tea.
If you like slow-paced building and decorating games, these Shorts are a good place to start.

name: Petit Planet
label: Cozy life
blurb: HoYoverse's cosmic life sim: grow your own tiny planet, farm, decorate, and visit friends in space.
seoDescription: Petit Planet Shorts from Haejoy: farming, decorating and visiting friends in HoYoverse's cozy space life sim, growing one tiny planet at a time.
description: Petit Planet is a cosmic life sim from HoYoverse where you look after your own tiny planet: farming, decorating, and slowly turning a small rock in space into a home.
On the channel, Petit Planet Shorts follow that progress in bite-sized pieces, from the first patch of crops to visiting friends' planets and showing off new builds.
It mixes the soft, anime-style look of HoYoverse games with a calm life-sim loop, which makes it one of the coziest worlds on the shelf.

name: Loftia
label: Cozy

description: Loftia is one of the laid-back games on the channel's to-play list, picked for its relaxed pace and soft, welcoming look.
Shorts for Loftia will show first impressions and the small, satisfying moments that make cozy games worth slowing down for. Check back as more videos land.

name: NTE
label: Open world
blurb: Neverness to Everness. Exploring an urban fantasy city.
seoDescription: NTE (Neverness to Everness) Shorts from Haejoy: sightseeing and chill exploration in an anime-style urban fantasy open-world city, in quick clips.
description: NTE, short for Neverness to Everness, is an anime-style open-world game set in an urban fantasy city full of strange happenings hidden in everyday streets.
Haejoy's NTE Shorts lean into the sightseeing side: wandering the city, finding pretty corners, and sharing the moments that make an open world feel lived in.
If you enjoy exploring big anime cities at your own pace, this is the shelf to browse.

name: Ananta
label: Open world
blurb: An anime-style open world with a busy city to explore.
seoDescription: Ananta Shorts from Haejoy: first impressions and relaxed exploration of a busy anime-style open-world city, cut into short, cozy gameplay clips.
description: Ananta is an anime-style open-world game set in a busy, colorful city that invites you to explore every street and rooftop.
The channel covers Ananta with first impressions and exploration Shorts, focusing on the fun of discovering a new city rather than min-maxing it.
Expect quick, relaxed looks at what makes the world fun to wander around.

name: Sword of Justice
label: Open world
seoDescription: Sword of Justice Shorts from Haejoy: scenic spots, outfits and calm sightseeing in a wuxia-flavored open-world RPG, made to watch on a slow day.
description: Sword of Justice is a wuxia-flavored open-world RPG with sweeping landscapes, traditional architecture, and plenty of places to simply stand and look around.
Haejoy's Sword of Justice Shorts are mostly sightseeing: scenic spots, outfits, and calm moments between the action.
A good pick if you like your open worlds beautiful and a little slower.

name: Roblox

description: Roblox is a huge collection of player-made worlds, from house-building and role-play games to silly obstacle courses played with friends.
On the channel, Roblox Shorts cover cozy builds like dream houses, plus the fun moments that happen when you hop into a game together.
There is always something new to try, which keeps this shelf changing every week.
